verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack addresses data residency, regional storage options, or geographic control over where workspace data resides; one community comment even notes Notion is tied to its own cloud with no local storage option. This is a fair question for a SaaS platform storing user data, so it applies, but nothing supports it. missing for 10: any mention of region selection, data residency guarantees, EU/US data center choice, or compliance documentation on data locality.
